items.text: Can you pull together the Q4 revenue summary for the board pack? Need it by Thursday.
On it. Pulling Motor, Home, Life, and Travel lines — I'll flag anything that needs your sign-off.
Q4 revenue is $6.3M, up 23% on Q3. Motor is the driver — 38% of mix.
What's behind the claims ratio drop?
Primarily the Home segment — loss prevention programme cut frequency by ~12%. Two assumptions flagged for your review.
Looks good. Include the NPS trend too.
Done. Slide deck attached — 12 pages, all charts refreshed against the live data.
Perfect. Sending to the board tonight.
